title: AI Camera Mistakes Guitar for Helmetless Pillion Rider in Bengaluru, ₹500 Challan Issued
key_facts: A Bengaluru rider's wife received a ₹500 challan for 'pillion riding without helmet' after an AI camera allegedly mistook the guitar on the rider's back for a passenger.
The incident reportedly took place on 15 Sep 2026, when the rider was riding his wife's two-wheeler alone.
The rider posted an image on X, tagged Bengaluru Traffic Police and asked for the challan to be revoked.
Bengaluru Traffic Police asked him to email the authorities; he later confirmed the challan had been revoked.
The city's ITEMS system uses number-plate and violation-evidence cameras with AI and deep learning.
The police say detected violations are manually verified before an e-challan is generated; the article says the case raises questions about human checks.
